source: Binance spot USDT daily UTC close and quote_volume

data.eligibility: original close.notna(); exit from decision on first missing close
data.liquidity: 30-calendar-day rolling median of original quote volume; min 20 observed
data.delisting_fill: unpriced liquidation must be reported, never fabricated

timing.backtest_fill_assumption: previous close; 00:10 execution not certified by daily data

costs.cash_yield: research assumption; not asserted as real account income
costs.funding_fallback: BTC observed rate then 0.0003/day, explicitly tagged proxy; never observed zero
costs.execution_venues: BTC/ETH spot UBTC/UETH USDC pairs; all other assets original Hyperliquid perps, leverage setting 1
costs.accounting: daily drift rebalancing and post-cost NAV reserve; reference target-change-only costs recorded separately in audit

universe.production: all discovered Binance spot USDT, excluding stable, leveraged, wrapped; historical membership from archives
universe.ties: deterministic alphabetical tie break, average liquidity ranks; deviation from reference set iteration reported

activation.execution_owner_after_operator_activatio: trendatlas-clean-production.service on VPS; mrv1-production remains disabled

execution.credentials: existing Supabase hyperliquid_agent_secrets AES-256-GCM; KEK from /etc/trendatlas-production/multi-account.env; never export a systemd signing key
execution.risk_budget_sizing: post-cost NAV reserve and floor quantities, target sum <=1, visible exchange minimum dust
execution.native_vps_validation: 92 Python tests, 250 TypeScript tests, typecheck/build, 18 checkpoints and read-only per-account preflight before activation
execution.authorized_target: weights dictionary with sum <= 1; identical signal for every consenting account, equity-sized per account
execution.source_bundle_manifest: unpack preserves the original BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json bytes at release root after validating every source file; tests must not require a Git checkout

public_performance.chart: Clean vs BTC buy and hold, log scale, common window
public_performance.signal_source: signal.json ciel_vahy; D+1, no second shift
public_performance.reference_metrics: user targets are unverified acceptance references, never hardcoded public values
public_performance.funding_proxies: explicitly disclosed; never labelled observed Binance funding
